About the Role
The Assistant Manager – Strategic Planning & Insights at Delmo Chicken & Agro (Pvt) Ltd will support the Group’s strategic growth agenda by researching new business and investment opportunities, evaluating market potential and internal capabilities, and preparing feasibility studies and business cases. The role will also support decision-making for senior management and monitor approved projects against investment assumptions, milestones and expected returns, highlighting risks and recommending corrective actions when required.
Key Responsibilities
•	Identify and screen potential business, market-entry and investment opportunities by monitoring industries, technologies and adjacent markets.
•	Conduct market and competitor research, including market sizing, growth trends, customer needs, regulations and industry value chains.
•	Assess opportunities against Delmo’s strategy, existing capabilities, operational readiness, potential synergies and capability gaps.
•	Prepare feasibility studies and investment business cases with Finance and business teams, covering commercial and operational viability.
•	Develop financial models and evaluate CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, margins, cash flows and investment returns using NPV, IRR, payback and relevant measures.
•	Conduct risk, sensitivity and scenario analyses; recommend practical alternatives such as phasing, partnerships or changes to project scope.
•	Prepare clear presentations and evidence-based recommendations for senior management on whether to proceed, modify, partner, defer or stop opportunities.
